comments.text: IMO - People have destroyed the definition, benefits of, and security of marriage by attacking it because of their current feelings. Marriage was a religious bond first and government practice was secondary; and intended to support marriages when both spouses executed per the contract. Unfortunately, like the chef, marriage works well until it either or both parties reneges. The problems the chef talked about with his divorce were all problems associated with how the government in the US treats divorces, not marriages. A logical person wouldn’t enter in a codependent relationship without a contract and if terms can’t be agreed to, they keep the relationship at more superficial level.
